_comment: Inner object of the { data: ... } envelope the diagnostics route returns (builder src/app/api/olympus/voice/diagnostics/route.ts, action=diagnose_setup). dids_without_e911 is the route's raw count of is_active DIDs with a null e911_address_id - it does NOT exempt toll-free numbers, which is the seeded inflation trap (3 reported; the pinned blocking_issues string is the route's own template). verified_e911_addresses counts voice_e911_addresses rows with verified_at NOT NULL.

blocking_issues: 3 active DID(s) have no E911 address — calls may not connect emergency services.
